system_scope.purpose: 할 일 관리를 위한 간단한 REST API입니다.

features.name: Create Task
features.description: Allow users to create a new task with details such as title, description, and due date.

features.name: Read Task
features.description: Allow users to retrieve details of a specific task using its unique identifier.

features.name: Update Task
features.description: Allow users to update the details of an existing task, including title, description, and due date.

features.name: Delete Task
features.description: Allow users to delete a task using its unique identifier.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to log in with email and password
acceptance_criteria: User can login with valid credentials
Invalid credentials show error message

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to create an account with email and password
acceptance_criteria: User can register with valid email and matching passwords
Duplicate email shows error message
Password strength validation is enforced

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Allow users to reset their password using a reset link
acceptance_criteria: User can reset password with valid reset token
New password must meet security criteria

features.name: User Logout
features.description: Allow users to log out from the application
acceptance_criteria: User can logout successfully
Invalid or expired token shows error message

features.name: Two-Factor Authentication
features.description: Provide an additional layer of security by requiring a second form of verification during login
acceptance_criteria: User can enable/disable two-factor authentication
Valid two-factor code allows access
Invalid code shows error message

features.name: Create Todo Item
features.description: Allow users to create a new todo item via the API.
acceptance_criteria: Todo item is created with valid inputs
API returns the unique todo_id
Creation timestamp is accurate

features.name: Read Todo Item
features.description: Allow users to retrieve details of a specific todo item.
acceptance_criteria: Todo item details are returned for a valid todo_id
Error message is shown for an invalid todo_id

features.name: Update Todo Item
features.description: Allow users to update the details of an existing todo item.
acceptance_criteria: Todo item is updated with valid inputs
API returns the updated timestamp
Error message is shown for an invalid todo_id

features.name: Delete Todo Item
features.description: Allow users to delete a specific todo item.
acceptance_criteria: Todo item is deleted for a valid todo_id
Deletion confirmation is returned
Error message is shown for an invalid todo_id

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Authenticate users and provide access to API endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in with valid credentials
Invalid credentials return an error message

features.name: Task Due Date Reminder
features.description: Allow users to set reminders for tasks based on their due dates, notifying them via email or push notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: The requirement for reminders is often implied in a TODO application to enhance task management.

features.name: Recurring Tasks
features.description: Allow users to create tasks that recur on a regular basis (daily, weekly, monthly).
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Recurring tasks are a common feature in task management systems, enhancing usability for users with regular activities.

features.name: Task Search
features.description: Allow users to search for tasks based on keywords in the title or description.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Search functionality is a standard feature in applications that manage lists of items, improving user experience.

features.name: Task Sorting
features.description: Allow users to sort tasks based on various criteria such as due date, priority, or creation date.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Sorting is a common feature that enhances the usability of task management applications.

features.name: List Tasks
features.description: Allow users to retrieve a list of all tasks, optionally filtered by status or due date.

features.name: Complete Task
features.description: Allow users to mark a task as completed.

features.name: Reopen Task
features.description: Allow users to reopen a task that was previously marked as completed.

features.name: Password Reset Request
features.description: Allow users to request a password reset via email
acceptance_criteria: User can request a password reset with valid email
Invalid email shows error message

features.name: Session Timeout
features.description: Automatically log users out after a period of inactivity
acceptance_criteria: User is logged out after specified inactivity period
User receives notification before timeout

features.name: List Todo Items
features.description: Allow users to retrieve a list of all their todo items.
acceptance_criteria: List of todo items is returned for a valid user_id
Empty list is returned if no todos exist for the user

features.name: API Error Handling
features.description: Provide standardized error responses for API requests.
acceptance_criteria: Error messages are clear and informative
Correct HTTP status codes are returned based on error type

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Allow users to manage their profile information, including updating email, password, and other personal details.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: User profile management is a standard feature in applications that require user accounts.

features.name: Set Task Priority
features.description: Allow users to set or update the priority level of a task (e.g., low, medium, high).

features.name: Add Task Comment
features.description: Allow users to add comments or notes to a specific task.

features.name: Get Task Comments
features.description: Allow users to retrieve all comments associated with a specific task.
